thread:
nina: heads up attempting to cut v1.6.0 and the generated client diff is failing our publish gate. typegen-bot shows an enum rename (RateLimited -> Throttled) and ResponseMeta keys reordered. this is breaking our retry matcher in the runtime. blocking the release.

charlie: ack. is the enum rename coming from the API contract or our generator mapping?

rui: checked the OpenAPI bundle  upstream changed the enum value intentionally. generator faithfully emitted the new symbol. ordering is harmless but enums are breaking.

typegen-bot: regen report at 1810126600: changed packages/client/src/api.ts (one file). Delta: enum RateLimitReason { RateLimited } -> { Throttled }; ResponseMeta: now parses as { request_id, status, meta } vs old { status, meta, request_id } (ordering only).

nina: runtime's retry matcher expects "RateLimited" string in the error body. with Throttled it no longer retries in some flows causing e2e failures in sample-apps. CI shows intermittent 429s that do not trigger retry.

charlie: options: 1) treat as breaking and bump minor 1.6.0, update changelog and migrations. 2) add a compatibility shim mapping Throttled -> RateLimited in runtime and cut a patch to unblock. 3) ask API team to maintain alias for a deprecation cycle.

rui: API team already said they want the rename but can support aliasing for one release if we ask. might be simpler to ship a patch shim now and follow up with minor that surfaces new enum.

nina: patch plan: add runtime mapping + unit + small e2e that simulates a 429 with Throttled and ensure retry fires. pin generator in CI to prevent flapping during release window. then cut 1.5.1 (patch) and schedule 1.6.0 later with migration notes.

charlie: how do we pin generator? I've seen two approaches: lock the typegen devDependency to a semver & lockfile, or pin the Docker image/digest used in CI job. Docker pin is fastest.

rui: agree, pin the GHCR image digest in buildkite step. also add a note to the release checklist requiring a manual bump of the image digest with a changelog entry when regenerating.

nina: i'll open the PR for the shim and tests. changelog entry: "fix(retry): accept Throttled enum alias for RateLimited to preserve retry behavior". also adding e2e to presubmit matrix.

charlie: i'll update .buildkite/pipelines/release.yml with: ```yaml
- label: typegen:regen
  image: ghcr.io/redwood/typegen@sha256:ef12a9c3...
  command: pnpm -w run typegen:regen
```
add instructions in RELEASE.md about bumping the digest.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/4410 triggered: packages/sample-apps  e2e  auth.spec.ts (flaky: 1 failed)

rui: logs show initial 429 returned with body: `{ "error": { "type": "Throttled", "message": "too many requests" } }` and our matcher ignored it because it looked for `RateLimited`.

nina: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/10233 - runtime shim + tests + changelog + CI pin note.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/4412 started: PR 10233 (nina)

charlie: if CI green we publish patch 1.5.1 and unfreeze the release. ensure release notes include "compat: runtime alias for Throttled -> RateLimited; pinned typegen generator in CI".

rui: follow-up: create TCK ticket to add a typegen-version check to the release script and a small integration that runs e2e retry spec on every PR touching client/runtime. id: TCK-300.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/4412 passed.

nina: released v1.5.1 with compatibility shim. tagging follow-up for full minor 1.6.0 that will remove shim and include migration docs.

charlie: nice work. added note in onboarding docs about determinism for regen and how to update generator digest.

rui: i'm going to coordinate with API team for a deprecation schedule so downstreams have time to migrate to Throttled. thanks folks. :shipit:

nina: closing the loop.
